about: The pinned upstream sources of registry/*.json. build.mjs turns this file into registry/SOURCES.md; sources.lock.json holds the SHA-256 of every download.

sources.name: Reference-LAPACK (BLAS and LAPACK)
sources.uses: Routine names, arguments and result types from the code; intents and types from `\param`; summaries from `\brief` (or the first sentence of Purpose when the brief is only the name); precision families from `\ingroup`; family titles from DOCS/groups-usr.dox; hint tags from the argument documentation; the library from the folder (BLAS/SRC, with its lsame, xerbla and xerbla_array, is the BLAS).
sources.copied: Summaries and family titles, which are BSD-licensed.

sources.name: Netlib LAPACK documentation, Doxygen search index
sources.version: 3.12.1, as published (Netlib keeps no older builds)
sources.uses: The anchor of each routine's member page.

sources.name: Reference-ScaLAPACK (ScaLAPACK, PBLAS, BLACS, REDIST and TOOLS)
sources.uses: Routine names and arguments from the code (SRC, TOOLS, PBLAS, REDIST, BLACS, and the error handler PBLAS/SRC/PTZBLAS/pxerbla.f); scope (global or local), intent and type from the Arguments prose; summaries from the first sentence of Purpose; hint tags.

sources.name: Netlib ScaLAPACK documentation, Doxygen search index
sources.uses: The anchor of each routine's member page.

sources.name: Open MPI
sources.uses: The one-line summaries of the man pages (docs/man-openmpi/man3/*.3.rst) and which routines have a page in the 5.0.x documentation; the derived types of mpi_f08 with their public components (ompi/mpi/fortran/use-mpi/mpi-types.F90.in) and null handles (ompi/mpi/fortran/use-mpi-f08/mod/mpi-f08-types.F90).
sources.copied: Summaries, which are BSD-licensed; the names of the types, their components and null handles.

sources.name: Open MPI machine-readable API catalogue (openmpi-mpi-api.jsonl)
sources.uses: The MPI procedures callable from Fortran, their category (collective, point-to-point, …), their `mpi_f08` arguments (name, intent, type, optional) and their kind (standard or deprecated); the type `use mpi` and mpif.h give each `mpi_f08` type (the same argument in those bindings).
sources.copied: Names, categories and argument lists; none of its parameter descriptions.

sources.name: Open MPI man pages, development branch
sources.uses: Summaries of the routines that have no man page in Open MPI 5.0.x (MPI 4.1 and 5.0 additions).

sources.name: MPI ABI stubs (mpi-forum/mpi-abi-stubs)
sources.uses: The MPI 5.0 procedure list (to check the catalogue is complete), the callback prototypes and the predefined callback functions of mpi.h; its handle types and null handles, to check Open MPI's.

sources.name: MPI Standard 5.0 and 4.1, HTML editions (unofficial)
sources.licence: © University of Tennessee; copying without fee permitted
sources.uses: Which page defines each procedure in each version (found from the contents, the function index and the binding on the page), which procedures are new in 5.0, and the pages of the sections on handles (Opaque Objects) and on the status (Return Status).
sources.copied: Page numbers only; none of the standard's text.

sources.name: OpenMP API Specification, HTML editions: contents pages
sources.uses: The names of directives, clauses, routines, environment variables and types, with the page and fragment ID of their sections in each version.
sources.copied: Names, page names and fragment IDs only; none of the specification's prose. Our own one-liners describe the most used items.

sources.name: LLVM OpenMP runtime, Fortran module omp_lib
sources.uses: The Fortran interfaces of the omp_* runtime routines (arguments, their types and VALUE attributes, function results), and the kinds (omp_integer_kind and omp_logical_kind among them) and named constants of omp_lib.
sources.copied: Interface names, types and constant names only.

sources.name: OpenACC Application Programming Interface 3.4 (PDF): outline and section headings
sources.uses: The page of the section that documents each directive, clause, routine and environment variable: the page that prints the heading of its entry in the PDF's outline (the outline and the text of the pages are read).
sources.copied: Page numbers only. The names are the API's; the one-liners are our own.

sources.name: M_intrinsics (Fortran intrinsic procedure descriptions)
sources.uses: Intrinsic procedure names, categories, one-line descriptions and call synopses (arguments, optional ones in brackets).
sources.copied: Categories, one-liners and argument names, which are MIT-licensed.

sources.name: fortran-lang.org, Sphinx inventory of the intrinsics pages
sources.version: objects.inv as published, pinned by SHA-256; site repository at bbdc33ec7bfc06fa6111093ae9712a7f7837b555
sources.uses: The page and anchor of each intrinsic on fortran-lang.org.

sources.name: GCC 16.1.0 gfortran manual, Intrinsic Procedures index
sources.uses: Which intrinsics have a page in the gfortran manual, so that links only point to pages that exist.
sources.copied: Page names only; none of the manual's text.
